rows.label: Winnie the Pooh
rows.description: fictional character created by A. A. Milne
rows.hook: is a honey-loving stuffed bear who lives in the Hundred Acre Wood with his friends

rows.label: Foghorn Leghorn
rows.hook: is a loud, blustering rooster with a Southern drawl who torments a barnyard dog

rows.label: Bugs Bunny
rows.hook: is a wisecracking gray hare who munches carrots and asks 'What's up, Doc?'

rows.label: Hello Kitty
rows.hook: is a white cartoon cat with a red bow and no visible mouth

rows.label: Mickey Mouse
rows.description: American cartoon character and mascot of The Walt Disney Company
rows.hook: is the cheerful round-eared mascot who debuted in Steamboat Willie

rows.label: Snoopy
rows.description: fictional dog from the comic strip ''Peanuts'' by Charles m. Schulz
rows.hook: is a beagle who imagines himself a World War I flying ace atop his doghouse

rows.label: Daffy Duck
rows.hook: is a lisping black waterfowl whose greed and bad luck make him a frustrated foil

rows.label: Paddington Bear
rows.description: children's book character created by Michael Bond
rows.hook: is a polite traveler from darkest Peru who loves marmalade sandwiches and wears a red hat

rows.label: Pepé Le Pew
rows.hook: is a skunk who relentlessly romances unwilling cats with his French accent

rows.label: Aslan
rows.description: fictional lion, a deity in The Chronicles of Narnia
rows.hook: is the golden lion who rules a magical land reached through a wardrobe

rows.label: Tweety
rows.hook: is a tiny yellow canary who keeps escaping a persistent cat

rows.label: Tasmanian Devil
rows.hook: is a growling, ravenous brute who travels as a whirling tornado

rows.label: Curious George
rows.description: protagonist of a series of popular children's books by the same name
rows.hook: is a mischievous monkey supervised by the Man in the Yellow Hat

rows.label: Speedy Gonzales
rows.hook: is the fastest mouse in Mexico, shouting 'Arriba!' as he runs

rows.label: Sonic the Hedgehog
rows.description: video game character from the eponymous video game franchise
rows.hook: is a blue, spiky speedster who collects golden rings and wears red sneakers

rows.label: Cheshire Cat
rows.description: character from Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
rows.hook: is a grinning feline who fades away until only his smile remains

rows.label: Donald Duck
rows.hook: is a short-tempered, sailor-suited waterfowl whose rants are hard to understand

rows.label: Goofy
rows.hook: is a tall, clumsy dog in a tall hat known for a 'gawrsh' and a signature yell

rows.label: Felix the Cat
rows.hook: is a black feline with a wide grin who paces with his hands behind his back

rows.label: Eeyore
rows.hook: is a gloomy gray donkey who keeps losing his tail

rows.label: Droopy
rows.hook: is a sad-faced basset hound who calmly beats his foes in a slow drawl

rows.label: Kermit the Frog
rows.hook: is the green puppet who hosts a variety show and sings about how hard it is to be green

rows.label: Scooby-Doo
rows.hook: is a cowardly Great Dane who solves mysteries with teen friends and snack bribes

rows.label: Porky Pig
rows.hook: is a stuttering pink porker who ends cartoons with 'That's all, folks!'

rows.label: Sylvester
rows.description: fictional anthropomorphic cat in the Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies series of cartoons
rows.hook: is a lisping black-and-white cat who forever chases a canary

rows.label: Woody Woodpecker
rows.hook: is a red-crested bird famous for a manic, high-pitched laugh

rows.label: Garfield
rows.hook: is a lasagna-loving orange tabby who hates Mondays

rows.label: Yogi Bear
rows.hook: is a necktie-wearing picnic-basket thief living in Jellystone Park

rows.label: Miss Piggy
rows.hook: is a glamorous diva who karate-chops anyone in the way of her romance with a frog

rows.label: Pink Panther
rows.hook: is a smooth, wordless, rose-colored cat who first appeared in a film's opening credits

rows.label: Mighty Mouse
rows.hook: is a caped rodent who swoops in to 'save the day' with an operatic song

rows.label: Simba
rows.hook: is a young prince who runs away to a carefree life with a meerkat and a warthog

rows.label: Woodstock
rows.hook: is a tiny yellow bird whose chirps show up as scratchy little lines

rows.label: Scar
rows.description: fictional character and main antagonist from The Lion King
rows.hook: is a scheming uncle who betrays his brother and rules alongside a pack of hyenas

rows.label: Peter Rabbit
rows.description: fictional character in children's books by Beatrix Potter
rows.hook: is a naughty bunny in a blue jacket who sneaks into Mr. McGregor's garden

rows.label: Donkey
rows.hook: is a talkative sidekick who sticks with an ogre and loves waffles

rows.label: Tom Cat
rows.description: fictional cat from the Tom & Jerry animation series
rows.hook: is a gray feline whose schemes to catch a clever mouse always backfire

rows.label: Lassie
rows.hook: is a loyal collie who rescues people and fetches help for her young owner

rows.label: Brian Griffin
rows.description: fictional character from the Family Guy franchise
rows.hook: is a martini-drinking talking dog who writes novels and lives with a bumbling suburban household
